name: 藤上自然熟箱装小番茄款
description: 皮薄多汁、自然熟采摘的红润小番茄详情页套图，桃橘海报加白卡红字信息语法

styleLock.direction: warm peach-cream fresh fruit detail-page commerce, poster hero plus white rounded-card info system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: cream blush page field #FBE9DC carrying large pure white #FFFFFF rounded cards with a 24px radius; one soft peach gradient panel #F7C9A6 behind the opening poster hero; deep living-leaf green only inside the vine growing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright warm soft daylight from the top-front, 5000K, soft fill, gentle contact shadows and shimmering water-droplet highlights, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte cream tabletop #F6E7DA, pale light-wood bowl #E4C9A4, plain white ceramic plate, always with a visible contact shadow
styleLock.typography: modern rounded geometric sans-serif headlines in #E8422E with a short red underline dash, small #5F544D body lines, vertical rounded red pill tabs #E8422E with white vertical labels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin 2px line icons drawn in white or #E8422E, single stroke weight, never filled circular badge rows
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale, tile compositions inside rounded white cards, glossy skin with visible water droplets, at least one cut cross-section shown, alternating photo and text columns in zigzag rows
noDrift: no green frame or round wood tray hero props
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm peach-cream fresh-produce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cream blush #FBE9DC, warm taupe-grey text #5F544D and one vivid tomato-red accent #E8422E; warm tone; consistent cream blush #FBE9DC page fields carrying large pure white #FFFFFF rounded cards with a 24px radius, plus one soft peach gradient #F7C9A6 poster panel; bright warm soft daylight from the top-front with soft fill, 5000K, gentle contact shadows and shimmering water-droplet highlights, no harsh speculars; modern rounded geometric sans-serif headlines only in #E8422E with a short red underline dash and small #5F544D body lines; consistent vertical rounded red pill tabs #E8422E with white vertical labels; consistent thin 2px line icons in white or #E8422E, never filled badge rows; the product rendered glossy and fresh with visible water droplets, one cut cross-section shown, stable centered scale with a visible contact shadow; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no filled circular badge rows, no green frame or round wood tray hero props.

shots.intent: 首屏海报抓眼，用飞溅果汁与悬浮果串一秒传达多汁爆汁感
shots.camera: straight-on front group view with fruit floating mid-air at a slight 3/4 lift, full composition visible
shots.lighting: bright warm front-left studio key, 5000K, glossy specular highlights on every droplet, soft grounded shadows
shots.background: soft peach gradient #F7C9A6 fading into cream blush #FBE9DC with one clean vertical lighter panel behind the headline
shots.props: one clear glass bowl at the bottom holding a small pile of the product; one arcing splash of its own fruit juice sweeping through the right side
shots.textZone: left third vertical band: one large headline 「{callout_1}」 in #E8422E, one small rounded vertical tag 「{selling_point_1}」 filled #E8422E with white text
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail-page hero poster of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Composition: whole pieces of {product} floating mid-air at a slight 3/4 lift with one cut cross-section half resting at the bottom, a clear glass bowl holding a small pile below, and one arcing splash of the product's own juice sweeping through the right side; straight-on front view, the floating fruit, bowl and splash together filling 50-60% of the frame. Bright warm front-left studio key light, 5000K, glossy specular highlights on every water droplet, soft grounded shadows under the bowl. Background soft peach gradient #F7C9A6 fading into cream blush #FBE9DC with one clean vertical lighter panel behind the headline. The left third of the frame carries one large headline 「{callout_1}」 in #E8422E and one small rounded vertical tag filled #E8422E with white text 「{selling_point_1}」, the poster reading as one complete balanced composition. Commercial fresh-produce e-commerce quality. Negative: no fake brand wordmark, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off fruit at the frame edges, no duplicated floating fruit, no physics-defying splash, no plastic-looking skin.

shots.intent: 白卡承接首屏，用一句双段卖点加断面近景说清红润清甜多汁
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down onto the card, the cut cross-section sharp in the lower half
shots.lighting: warm soft top light, 5000K, front fill, wet glossy highlights on the cut face
shots.background: one pure white #FFFFFF rounded card (24px radius) centered on the cream blush field #FBE9DC
shots.textZone: upper half of the white card: one two-part headline 「{callout_1}」 in #E8422E with a short red underline dash beneath it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero card for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Composition: one whole glossy piece with one cut cross-section beside it, placed in the lower half of a pure white #FFFFFF rounded card, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down onto the card, the cut face sharp, the fruit and card together filling 50-60% of the frame as one balanced card layout. Warm soft top light, 5000K, front fill, wet glossy highlights on the cut face and water droplets on the skin. The card sits centered on the cream blush field #FBE9DC. The upper half of the card completes the layout with one two-part headline 「{callout_1}」 in #E8422E with a short red underline dash beneath it. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented sweetness numbers or nutrition figures, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 用果皮光泽与水珠的极近距离证明新鲜度与薄皮质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro on the fruit skin at a low grazing angle with a 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, foreground droplets sharp
shots.lighting: raking side light from the left, 5200K, controlled highlights stringing along each droplet
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tight zoom on the glossy skin surface with beaded water droplets and one fresh green stem or calyx tip entering the upper corner; shot with a 100mm macro lens at a low grazing angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground droplets sharp. Raking side light from the left, 5200K, controlled highlights stringing along the droplets. Background softly blurred cream blush #FBE9DC. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal soft out-of-focus margin, because the droplet detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no over-smoothed plastic-looking skin, no duplicated droplets, no props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 同机位对切断面双格对比，直观证明果肉与汁水的差距
shots.camera: two matched panels with identical straight-on macro framing on the cut face, same lens, crop and scale in both panels
shots.lighting: identical soft top-front light, 5000K, in both panels; only the flesh state differs
shots.background: two identical pure white #FFFFFF rounded cards on the cream blush field #FBE9DC
shots.textZone: one short caption under each card 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #E8422E
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce matched comparison of {product}, two panels with identical straight-on macro framing on the cut face, same lens, crop and scale. Left panel: a generic stored piece of the same produce kind with pale, dry, low-juice flesh under flat light, no brand and no text. Right panel: a halved {product} with deep glossy flesh, visible seeds and juice beading on the cut face. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both cut faces photographed straight-on with identical soft top-front light, 5000K; only the flesh state differs while camera, crop and lighting stay exactly matched. Two identical pure white #FFFFFF rounded cards sit on the cream blush field #FBE9DC with even panel margins, each cut face filling about 50-60% of its card. One short caption 「{callout_1}」 under the left card and 「{callout_2}」 under the right card in #E8422E finishes the paired layout. Negative: no fabricated test data or statistics, no exaggerated decay, no brand names or logos, no mismatched framing or lighting between the two panels, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 生长环境信任背书，用藤上挂果实拍加三枚细线图标讲清生长条件
shots.camera: eye-level close view of a single fruit truss still hanging on the living vine, fruit sitting slightly low in the frame, foliage softly blurred behind
shots.lighting: natural warm daylight from the upper right, 5600K, dappled leaf shadows, gentle backlight through the leaves
shots.background: living vine foliage in deep leaf green #3F6B39 with bright sky gaps, softly out of focus
shots.props: the vine truss with its leaves; nothing else
shots.textZone: top band: one row of three thin white 2px line icons (a sun, a rain cloud, a thermometer), each above a short label 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce growing-environment trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A close eye-level view of a single fruit truss still hanging on the living vine, the truss filling 50-60% of the frame with the fruit sitting slightly low and softly blurred foliage behind. Natural warm daylight from the upper right, 5600K, dappled leaf shadows and a gentle backlight through the leaves. Background of living vine foliage in deep leaf green #3F6B39 with bright sky gaps, softly out of focus. The top band completes the frame with one row of three thin white 2px line icons, a sun, a rain cloud and a thermometer, each above a short white label 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 in #FFFFFF, the icon row and truss reading as one balanced composition. Negative: no fabricated origin, organic or certification claims, no numbers or statistics, no dense body text, no duplicated leaves or fruit, no extra icons beyond the three, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 爆汁断面微距，用籽粒与汁水证明皮薄多汁的口感
shots.camera: macro shot photographed directly overhead at a 90-degree angle, the cut cross-section filling the frame, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft even top light, 5000K, clean wet gloss on the cut face, gentle highlights on the seeds
shots.background: matte cream #F6E7DA, fully out of focus
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of one freshly cut half of {product}, tight on the cut face so the thin skin, glistening juicy flesh and small seeds are all visible with juice beading on the surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with a 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, the cut surface sharp. Soft even top light, 5000K, clean wet gloss on the cut face and gentle highlights on the seeds. Background matte cream tabletop #F6E7DA fully out of focus. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a thin minimal margin, because the juicy cut face is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no over-saturated fake flesh tones, no duplicated slices, no props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 规格与食用信息一次讲清，消除重量与储存方式的疑问

shots.lighting: even warm soft light, 5000K, soft contact shadow under the bowl
shots.background: one pure white #FFFFFF rounded card on the cream blush field #FBE9DC
shots.props: a pale light-wood bowl #E4C9A4 as the only prop, with a few water droplets on the rim
shots.productOccupancy: 50-60% for the bowl and spec column together
shots.textZone: right column: four short spec label rows 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_4}」 in #5F544D with small #E8422E label heads
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size-and-spec infographic card for {product}, a clean two-column rounded card layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left column: the product piled in a pale light-wood bowl #E4C9A4 with a few water droplets on the rim, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down. Even warm soft light, 5000K, a soft contact shadow under the bowl. One pure white #FFFFFF rounded card sits on the cream blush field #FBE9DC. Negative: no invented weights, origin or storage-certification claims, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra props.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张 800×1200 竖版爆款详情页切片提炼；已剥离店铺会员二维码卡片、店招与全部原文案（生长环境、规格、营养、吃法等文字），产地、基地、糖度、检测与销量一律未带入，统一改为 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 文案槽由使用方填入可核实内容；仅保留桃橘渐变爆汁海报、白圆角卡加红字下划线、细线图标行、对切双格对比、藤上挂果与竖向红标签等可复用排版语法。
